expected-rejections.json — W0 negative fixture index for ccos-1 regression net.
Each fixture in this directory is a known-bad record that the validator rejects.
This is the AC5b oracle: the validator MUST reject every fixture listed here.

HOW TO RUN (re-ported to Python 2026-07):
  python3 -m pytest coordinator/bin/tests/test_validator_negative_corpus.py -q

The loader is coordinator/bin/tests/test_validator_negative_corpus.py, a re-port of the
retired testNegativeCorpus(fixturesDir, schemasDir) from coordinator-claude
coordinator/bin/lib/schema.js (deleted in 480ad8f8, "D1: retire claude-klabauter oracle .js +
bin/lib/*.js", without a Python successor until this port). It drives this index against
coordinator_core.frontmatter.schema_validate.validate() / validate_memo_cross_fields().
See that module's docstring for the current known-gap list: completion-entry (c01-c05)
has no vendored Python schema, so those fixtures are marked xfail(strict=True) rather
than silently dropped.

NOTE: The validator does NOT currently enforce additionalProperties/unknown-field constraints.
  No negative fixture for that case is included — the current validator accepts unknown fields.
  If unknown-field rejection is added, add a fixture and expected verdict here.

NOTE: .json files are skipped by lint-frontmatter.js (see lint-frontmatter.js line ~217).
  The r01-diff-loc-wrong-type.json fixture (review-trail number type) is NOT in this index
  because lint-frontmatter.js never processes JSON files. Review-trail validation is tested
  separately. The number type check IS covered by c05 (loe.agent_dispatches).

NOTE: The bare-string "number-or-null" spec in completion-entry.yaml (chain_span_days) is
  silently passed by checkType (unknown type tag passthrough). Only object-spec {type: number-or-null}
  is enforced. c05 uses loe.agent_dispatches which uses the object-spec form.

NOTE (C2, 2026-07-08): the c2-*.md fixtures in this directory are OUT OF SCOPE for this
  index and testNegativeCorpus() — they are shape-VALID per schema.js (validateFrontmatter
  accepts them; expect_ok would be true here, breaking this oracle's all-false invariant).
  Their rejection is a write-time, filesystem/git-aware reachability check hosted in the
  PreToolUse hook (coordinator/hooks/scripts/validate-frontmatter-schema.js), deliberately
  NOT in schema.js (which stays filesystem/git-free by design). Their oracle lives in a
  sibling index: coordinator/bin/tests/fixtures/validator-negative/c2-expected-reachability.json.
  That hook has no Python port in this tree, so this index does not re-port c2 either.
  Spec backlink: docs/plans/2026-07-08-handoff-spinoff-robustness-hardening.md § C2
generator: W0 executor (ccos-1 regression net); H-CROSS-EXEC-1/-2 fixtures added by C2 (2026-07-17, docs/plans/2026-07-17-execution-handoff-phase-doe-contract.md); H-CROSS-9 fixtures added by C2b (2026-07-27, gate_dependency path-shaped rejection)

not_covered: additionalProperties/unknown-field (not enforced for non-skill schemas; skill schema DOES enforce it via additionalProperties:false — see bin/tests/fixtures/skill-negative-unknown-key.md for skill coverage)
iso-date type tag (functional for required fields; negative coverage implicit in h14 because missing required is caught first)

fixtures.rule_covered: M-CROSS-2: status=actioned + decision=accepted requires realized_by

errors.hint: Set realized_by to where the work landed: a plan path (docs/plans/*.md or tasks/<feature>/todo.md), a commit SHA, or the sentinel "inline". An accepted/partial memo realizes work and must carry a claim-of-record so a peer session does not re-realize it.

fixtures.rule_covered: M-CROSS-2b: realized_by must be inline, path, or hex SHA

errors.error: malformed realized_by "done_somewhere" when status=actioned and decision=accepted
errors.hint: realized_by must be one of: the sentinel "inline", a path containing "/" (e.g. docs/plans/2026-06-23-foo.md, tasks/<feature>/todo.md), or a hex commit SHA (7–64 hex chars). A bare word reads as authoritative but points nowhere.
